sample.Proj_Desc:
PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Includes full overhead lane control gantries with 1/3rd mile detection, DMS every mile, continuous fiber communications, wrong way detection, and ramp meters for I 515 from MP 14.72 to MP 20 to address queue and congestion issues. This concept also includes 5 locations for WWD ramp detection deployment as recommended by the WWD study. Project to keep CCTV and detection where applicable along corridor and only includes nominal values for those devices if additions are required for ATM implementation. This project concept includes CCTV and CV devices spaced every 2 miles, typically located near on or off ramps where these devices do not already exist. Where power is available, connection to power is desired. Solar powered devices may be required if no connection to power is readily available. This project already has existing continuous fiber coverage and therefore does not include any new fiber recommended as identified in the GeoHub as "Duct Available - Fiber Available".

NDOT PROJECT SCOPING PROCESS: For TECHNOLOGY STRATEGIES RECOMMENDED FOR THIS PROJECT CONCEPT, see columns U and V for "Geographic Strategies" and "Performance Strategies" in the excel file. For DATA BEHIND STRATEGY RECOMMENDATIONS, see PowerBI tool and select appropriate TMC segment along NDOT roadways. For WHICH TECHNOLOGIES APPLY TO WHICH TYPES OF GEO OR PERF STRATEGIES, see "Strategies Tree (Segment Prioritization Tool)" tab in the excel file. For SPECIFIC DESIGN CONSIDERATIONS FOR SPECIFIC TECHNOLOGIES, see tab "Attachment K - Design Info"  in the excel file. Only technologies are considered in project concepts; therefore, any static signage, pavement, curb/gutter, markings, or other design activities beyond the technology design components described in Attachment K would need to be added in the scoping process.

STIP REFERENCE: There is an existing STIP project #CL20200033 for an I 515 Rehab/Retrofit I-1449, H-1449 at Boulder Hwy and Sahara 3R project for $800K in construction year 2024. There is also an existing STIP project #CL20170034 for an I 515/US 95 HOV Half Interchange Construction at City Parkway road improvement project for $14.1M in construction year 2024. NDOT should make sure to collaborate between this project concept and that existing STIP project to incorporate any necessary stub outs as may be utilized by this project concept once implemented. NDOT should also consider if there is an opportunity to incorporate these project requests within these existing STIP projects.

sample.Title: Updated ITS Standards
sample.Proj_Desc: Project Description: Project and include additional material into the SLI Design Guide. Additional material should include new ITS details and standards for technologies in smart work zone, connected vehicle field infrastructure, ITS edge devices, wrong way systems, new types of ITS vaults and pull boxes, ATM overhead lane control gantry details, and controllers to support ATSPM. Update conduit system design criteria and design standards and fiber cable sharing physical infrastructure requirements to support broadband use by public and private agencies. Updated ITS standards should include communication protocols and incorporate the recommendations from the Asset Management Program as related to naming conventions for cabinets, switches, and IP addressing, etc. All ITS standards are captured or referenced in the SLI Design Guide, which should also be the location for ATM standards particularly as NDOT expands the ATM system to additional areas.
